class.name: CSGGeometryData
class.brief_description: Semantic faces, edges, vertices, and adjacency for a CSG result.
class.description: A topology snapshot produced by [method CSGModifierContext.get_geometry_data]. Face arrays have [method get_face_count] entries. Face-edge and face-adjacency arrays have three entries per face. Edge vertex and edge face arrays have two entries per edge. A missing adjacent face is [code]-1[/code].

method.name: get_boundary_edges
method.description: Returns one boundary flag per edge.

method.name: get_brush_ids
method.description: Returns source brush ordinals.

method.name: get_layer_ids
method.description: Returns semantic layer IDs. [CSGHeightMap3D] uses the quantized height level as the layer ID.

method.name: get_edge_count
method.description: Returns the welded edge count.

method.name: get_edge_faces
method.description: Returns the two incident faces for each edge.

method.name: get_edge_sharpness
method.description: Returns the angle in radians between incident faces.

method.name: get_edge_vertices
method.description: Returns endpoint vertex indices for each edge.

method.name: get_face_adjacency
method.description: Returns the face across each triangle edge, or [code]-1[/code].

method.name: get_face_count
method.description: Returns the triangle face count.

method.name: get_face_custom_metadata
method.description: Returns per-face custom dictionaries.

method.name: get_face_edges
method.description: Returns three edge indices per face.

method.name: get_face_generation
method.description: Returns face generation tags.

method.name: get_face_ids
method.description: Returns stable face IDs.

method.name: get_face_semantics
method.description: Returns semantic names.

method.name: get_material_ids
method.description: Returns material IDs.

method.name: get_sharp_edges
method.description: Returns one sharp flag per edge. Boundary edges are sharp.

method.name: get_source_face_ids
method.description: Returns originating face IDs.

method.name: get_surface_ids
method.description: Returns surface IDs.

method.name: get_triangle_vertices
method.description: Returns three welded vertex indices per face.

method.name: get_vertex_adjacency
method.description: Returns an array of neighboring vertex index arrays.

method.name: get_vertex_count
method.description: Returns the welded geometry vertex count.

method.name: get_vertex_faces
method.description: Returns an array of incident face index arrays.

method.name: get_vertices
method.description: Returns welded geometry vertex positions.

constants.constant: Face comes directly from a source surface.
Face was newly exposed by subtraction.
Face was generated by topology processing.
